extra_vocab.en: covered with oil or full of oil or fat
extra_vocab.note: 多益最常見在餐廳評論、出差用餐與工廠、設備情境。形容食物時帶負面語感，表示太油、不健康；形容手或零件時指沾到油汙。

example.en: The food at that cafe is greasier than the one near our office.
example.zh: 那家咖啡館的食物比我們辦公室附近那家更油膩。

example.en: That was the greasiest burger I have ever had at a business lunch.
example.zh: 那是我在商務午餐吃過最油膩的漢堡。

example.en: Our client does not like greasy food, so we chose a salad bar.
example.zh: 我們的客戶不喜歡油膩的食物，所以我們選了沙拉吧。

example.en: Please wash your greasy hands before touching the new equipment.
example.zh: 碰新設備之前，請先洗掉你手上的油汙。

example.en: We grabbed a quick breakfast at a greasy spoon near the factory.
example.zh: 我們在工廠附近一家油膩的小餐館快速吃了早餐。

examples.en: The fried chicken was too greasy, so I left a low rating.
examples.zh: 炸雞太油了，所以我給了低分。

examples.en: The hotel breakfast was greasy, so I skipped it and had coffee.
examples.zh: 飯店早餐太油膩，所以我沒吃，只喝了咖啡。

examples.en: Wipe the greasy parts with a clean cloth before packing them.
examples.zh: 包裝之前，請用乾淨的布擦掉零件上的油汙。

examples.en: The greasy marks on the box made the shipping label hard to read.
examples.zh: 箱子上的油漬讓運送標籤很難閱讀。

confusable.diff: 拼法和發音都很像，但 grassy 是「長滿草的」，和油完全無關。

example.en: The outdoor meeting will be held on the grassy area behind the hall.
example.zh: 戶外會議將在大廳後方的草地上舉行。

similar.diff: oily 較中性，可指含油的東西（oily skin、oily sauce）；greasy 通常帶有「太油、不乾淨」的負面感。

example.en: The salad dressing is oily, but many customers like the taste.
example.zh: 這個沙拉醬有點油，但很多顧客喜歡它的味道。

example.en: The oily sauce left a stain on my report.
example.zh: 那個油油的醬汁在我的報告上留下污漬。

example.en: Doctors advise us to avoid fatty food at company dinners.
example.zh: 醫生建議我們在公司聚餐時避免高脂肪食物。

derived.link: grease 是詞幹；加 -y 表示「有…的」，變成 greasy，像 salty、oily
greasy 去 y 變 i + -ness，把形容詞變成名詞，像 kindness、business

extra_vocab.zh: 定價過高的、貴得不合理的
extra_vocab.en: costing more than it is worth
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於餐廳或商品評論、採購報價與市場分析。重點是「價格比價值高」，不只是貴；常用在 be 動詞後，或放在名詞前，如 an overpriced meal。

example.en: Customers complained that the overpriced products did not match the quality.
example.zh: 顧客抱怨價格過高的產品和品質不相稱。

example.en: The menu is nice, but the dishes are slightly overpriced.
example.zh: 菜單很不錯，但菜色的價格稍微偏高。

example.en: I think the service is overpriced for what you get.
example.zh: 我覺得以所得到的內容來說，這項服務太貴了。

examples.en: The food was good, but it felt overpriced for the portion size.
examples.zh: 食物很好吃，但以份量來說覺得太貴。

examples.en: We rejected the first quote because it was clearly overpriced.
examples.zh: 我們拒絕了第一份報價，因為它明顯太貴。

examples.en: Many analysts believe the company's shares are overpriced right now.
examples.zh: 許多分析師認為這家公司的股票目前被高估了。

examples.en: Your parts are overpriced compared with other suppliers, so we need a discount.
examples.zh: 你們的零件比其他供應商貴太多，所以我們需要折扣。

confusable.diff: overpriced 是形容詞，形容東西標價太高；overcharge 是動詞，指向顧客多收錢。
confusable.usage: overcharge 是及物動詞，常用 overcharge + 人 + for + 事物；overpriced 不能這樣接。

example.en: The shop overcharged me for the repair, so I asked for a refund.
example.zh: 那家店修理費多收了我的錢，所以我要求退款。

similar.diff: expensive 只是「貴」，不一定不值得；overpriced 表示貴得不合理。

example.en: This laptop is expensive, but it is worth the money.
example.zh: 這台筆電很貴，但物有所值。

similar.diff: pricey 是口語，語氣輕鬆；overpriced 較強，帶有批評。

example.en: The hotel is pricey, but the location is very convenient.
example.zh: 這間飯店有點貴，但位置非常方便。

example.en: Our new service is underpriced, so we are losing money.
example.zh: 我們的新服務定價過低，所以我們在賠錢。

example.en: We offer affordable rooms for small business travelers.
example.zh: 我們為小型商務旅客提供負擔得起的房間。

example.en: The supplier gave us a reasonable price for the whole order.
example.zh: 供應商為整筆訂單開出了合理的價格。

example.en: A mistake in the contract could be very costly.
example.zh: 合約裡的一個錯誤可能代價很高。

derived.link: price 是詞幹；overpriced = over（過度）+ priced（被定價的），價格過頭
price + -y，有…特性的，像 salty；去掉 e 後加 y
price + -ing，把「定價」變成名詞，像 pricing strategy

extra_vocab.en: good enough that waiting for it is not a problem
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於餐廳評論、產品上市、服務與出貨情境，表示結果很好，等再久也值得。可放在 be 動詞後，也可用在句尾補充評論。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: worth 後面接名詞或 V-ing（worth the wait、worth waiting），不接 to V；the wait 的 wait 在這裡是名詞。

examples.en: The restaurant was crowded, but the food was worth the wait.
examples.zh: 餐廳很擠，但食物值得等待。

examples.en: Our new phone arrives next month, and it will be worth the wait.
examples.zh: 我們的新手機下個月到貨，值得等待。

examples.en: Thank you for your patience; we hope the upgrade was worth the wait.
examples.zh: 感謝您的耐心；希望這次升級值得您等待。

examples.en: The custom furniture took six weeks, but it was worth the wait.
examples.zh: 這批訂製家具花了六週，但很值得等。

similar.diff: worth waiting for 意思相同，更直接用動詞；worth the wait 把 wait 當名詞，常用在評論句尾。

example.en: The final report is worth waiting for, so please be patient.
example.zh: 最終報告值得等待，所以請耐心等候。

similar.diff: well worth it 指整體「很值得」，不限於等待；worth the wait 專指等待這件事。

example.en: The training was long, but it was well worth it.
example.zh: 訓練很長，但非常值得。

confusable.diff: worth it 是「值得（花錢、花時間、花力氣）」，範圍較廣；worth the wait 專指等待。

example.en: The extra cost was worth it because the delivery was much faster.
example.zh: 多花的錢是值得的，因為交貨快多了。

extra_vocab.en: to list each thing separately, often with its cost
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於請款、報價、發票、出差報帳。要求對方 itemize，就是請他把費用一項一項寫清楚，而不是只給總額。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: itemize 是及物動詞，後面直接接受詞：itemize the costs，不加 about 或 for。英式拼法是 itemise。

example.en: Our accountant itemizes every expense in the monthly report.
example.zh: 我們的會計在月報中逐項列出每一筆支出。

example.en: The vendor itemized all the charges on the final invoice.
example.zh: 供應商在最終發票上逐項列出了所有費用。

example.en: Please send me an itemized receipt for the travel costs.
example.zh: 請寄給我差旅費用的明細收據。

example.en: She is itemizing the repair costs for the insurance claim.
example.zh: 她正在逐項列出保險理賠用的維修費用。

example.en: Please itemize your expenses before submitting the reimbursement form.
example.zh: 提交報銷單之前，請先逐項列出你的支出。

example.en: The supplier sent an itemized invoice with every part listed.
example.zh: 供應商寄來了列出每個零件的明細發票。

example.en: Could you itemize the costs so we can check each one?
example.zh: 你能逐項列出費用嗎？這樣我們可以一項一項檢查。

examples.en: Please itemize the charges so our finance team can review them.
examples.zh: 請逐項列出費用，讓我們的財務團隊可以審核。

examples.en: The quote does not itemize shipping, so we asked for details.
examples.zh: 這份報價沒有逐項列出運費，所以我們要求提供細節。

examples.en: Employees must itemize meals, hotels, and transport in the expense report.
examples.zh: 員工必須在報銷單上逐項列出餐費、住宿和交通費。

examples.en: Can you itemize the repair work in your next bill?
examples.zh: 你可以在下一張帳單中逐項列出維修工作嗎？

confusable.diff: itemize 是一項一項詳列；summarize 是把重點濃縮成簡短說明。

example.en: Please summarize the report in three short points before the meeting.
example.zh: 開會前，請用三個簡短重點摘要這份報告。

similar.diff: break down 把總額或整體拆成各部分，口語、常用於數字；itemize 更正式，常用於帳單與發票。

example.en: Could you break down the total cost by department?
example.zh: 你可以按部門拆解總成本嗎？

similar.diff: list 是一般的「列出」，不一定包含價格；itemize 強調每一項分開寫，通常附金額。

example.en: Please list every item that is included in the package price.
example.zh: 請列出套裝價格中包含的每一個項目。

example.en: We will send the invoice after the goods are delivered.
example.zh: 貨物送達之後，我們會寄出請款單。

example.en: Keep every receipt when you travel for work.
example.zh: 出差時請保留每一張收據。

example.en: The bank statement shows all payments made this month.
example.zh: 銀行對帳單列出了本月所有付款。

derived.link: item 是詞幹；itemize = item + -ize（使成為），把東西變成一項一項
itemize + -ation，把動作變成名詞，像 organize → organization

extra_vocab.en: a company outside your own company that sells goods or services to you
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於採購、合約、資訊安全與客服情境。third-party 指「不是我方、也不是對方，而是外部另一家」，所以 third-party vendor 就是外包或外部合作的供應商。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: third-party 當形容詞放在名詞前時要加連字號，而且 party 不加 s：a third-party vendor，不寫 third parties vendor。

examples.en: We hired a third-party vendor to manage our payroll system.
examples.zh: 我們聘請了第三方供應商來管理薪資系統。

examples.en: The delay was caused by a third-party vendor, not our own team.
examples.zh: 延誤是第三方供應商造成的，不是我們自己的團隊。

examples.en: Please contact the third-party vendor directly about the damaged shipment.
examples.zh: 關於受損的貨物，請直接聯絡第三方供應商。

examples.en: All third-party vendors must follow our data protection rules.
examples.zh: 所有第三方供應商都必須遵守我們的資料保護規定。

examples.en: Our company uses a third-party vendor for all printing orders.
examples.zh: 我們公司所有印刷訂單都使用第三方供應商。

similar.diff: outside supplier 較口語、說法較簡單；third-party vendor 更正式，強調「外部第三方」。

example.en: We bought the parts from an outside supplier last quarter.
example.zh: 我們上一季從外部供應商買了這些零件。

similar.diff: contractor 是承包商，常負責工程或專案工作；vendor 多半是賣東西或服務的供應商。

example.en: The contractor will finish the office renovation by the end of May.
example.zh: 承包商會在五月底前完成辦公室整修。

confusable.diff: 沒有連字號的 third party 是名詞，指「第三方」；加連字號的 third-party 才是放在名詞前的形容詞。
confusable.usage: third party 當名詞用，如 a third party；third-party 要放在名詞前修飾，如 a third-party vendor。

example.en: A third party will review the contract before we sign it.
example.zh: 簽約之前，會有第三方審閱這份合約。

confusable.diff: retailer 是零售商，直接賣給一般消費者；vendor 是供應商，常把商品或服務賣給公司。

example.en: The retailer sells our products directly to individual customers.
example.zh: 零售商把我們的產品直接賣給個別顧客。

extra_vocab.en: the rules about what can enter or leave a country
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於進出口、貨運、出差與採購情境。這裡的 customs 是「海關」，常搭配 customs duty（關稅）、customs form（報關單）、clear customs（通關）。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: customs 指「海關」時一定要加 s，不能寫成 custom regulations；custom（單數）是「習俗、慣例」。

examples.en: All goods must meet customs regulations before they enter the country.
examples.zh: 所有貨物進入該國之前都必須符合海關規定。

examples.en: Please check the customs regulations before you ship the samples abroad.
examples.zh: 把樣品寄到國外之前，請先確認海關規定。

examples.en: Travelers should read the customs regulations about cash and food items.
examples.zh: 旅客應該先閱讀關於現金與食品的海關規定。

examples.en: New customs regulations will take effect on the first of next month.
examples.zh: 新的海關規定將於下個月一日生效。

examples.en: Our supplier will handle the paperwork required by customs regulations.
examples.zh: 我們的供應商會處理海關規定要求的文件。

similar.diff: requirements 強調「必須符合的條件」；regulations 是正式的法規條文，語氣更官方。

example.en: Our broker will explain the customs requirements for medical equipment.
example.zh: 我們的報關行會說明醫療設備的海關要求。

similar.diff: import rules 較口語，也只限於進口；customs regulations 則涵蓋進出口與通關。

example.en: The import rules changed, so we need to update our price list.
example.zh: 進口規定改了，所以我們需要更新價目表。

confusable.diff: custom 是單數，意思是「習俗、慣例」，也可當形容詞「訂製的」；customs 加 s 才是「海關」。
confusable.usage: customs（海關）永遠是複數形；custom 單數指習俗，兩者意思完全不同。

example.en: It is a local custom to exchange small gifts at the first meeting.
example.zh: 第一次見面時互贈小禮物是當地的習俗。

confusable.diff: 拼法開頭很像，但 customer 是「顧客」，和海關無關。

example.en: Every customer receives a copy of the customs form with the order.
example.zh: 每位顧客的訂單都會附上一份報關單副本。

extra_vocab.zh: 光顧；以高人一等的態度對待
extra_vocab.en: to buy things regularly from a shop or restaurant
extra_vocab.note: 在多益中，patronize 多半是「光顧」，是正式說法，常出現在店家公告或廣告。但日常對話裡它更常指「用居高臨下的態度對人說話」，語氣不禮貌；don't patronize me 就是這個意思，意思是「別把我當小孩（或外行）看」。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: patronize 是及物動詞，「光顧」時直接接店家或場所：patronize a restaurant，不加 at 或 in。

example.en: Our CEO often patronizes local restaurants near the factory.
example.zh: 我們的執行長常光顧工廠附近的在地餐廳。

example.en: Many tourists patronized the hotel's restaurant during the conference week.
example.zh: 會議那一週有許多遊客光顧了飯店的餐廳。

example.en: Our team has been patronizing this supplier for over five years.
example.zh: 我們團隊光顧這家供應商已經超過五年了。

example.en: His patronizing tone made the new staff feel uncomfortable.
example.zh: 他居高臨下的語氣讓新進員工覺得不舒服。

example.en: Customers who patronize our store regularly get a ten percent discount.
example.zh: 經常光顧本店的顧客可享九折優惠。

example.en: We hope more residents will patronize local businesses this holiday season.
example.zh: 我們希望更多居民在這個假期光顧在地商家。

example.en: Please avoid a patronizing tone when you write to customers.
example.zh: 寫信給顧客時，請避免使用居高臨下的語氣。

examples.en: Thank you for patronizing our store during the holiday sale.
examples.zh: 感謝您在假期特賣期間光顧本店。

examples.en: The company encourages staff to patronize businesses in the neighborhood.
examples.zh: 公司鼓勵員工光顧附近的商家。

examples.en: Don't patronize me; I have worked in this field for ten years.
examples.zh: 別把我當外行；我在這個領域工作十年了。

examples.en: Your reply patronized our team, and we found it disrespectful.
examples.zh: 你的回覆對我們團隊擺出高高在上的態度，我們覺得很不尊重。

confusable.diff: sponsor 是出錢贊助活動、球隊或個人；patronize 是當顧客去光顧店家。
confusable.usage: patronize 的受詞通常是店、餐廳等店家；sponsor 的受詞是活動、團體或人。

example.en: Our bank will sponsor the city marathon again next year.
example.zh: 我們銀行明年會再次贊助城市馬拉松。

similar.diff: shop at 是一般口語說法；patronize 更正式，常出現在公告或商業文章。

example.en: I usually shop at the store near my hotel.
example.zh: 我通常在飯店附近那家店購物。

similar.diff: 這是 patronize 第二個意思的口語說法，指用高人一等的態度對人說話。

example.en: Please do not talk down to our junior staff.
example.zh: 請不要用高高在上的態度對待我們的資淺員工。

example.en: Every customer received a thank-you card with the order.
example.zh: 每位顧客的訂單都附了一張感謝卡。

example.en: Our client wants to change the delivery date.
example.zh: 我們的客戶想更改交貨日期。

example.en: The cafe gives free coffee to its regulars on Fridays.
example.zh: 這家咖啡館星期五提供常客免費咖啡。

derived.link: patron 是詞幹，指固定上門的客人；patronize = patron + -ize，做常客會做的事，也就是光顧
patron + -age，表示行為或集合，像 mileage；常見句子：Thank you for your patronage

senses.en: to buy goods or services from a shop or restaurant regularly
senses.distinguish: 受詞是店或餐廳；多用在公告或正式說法，語氣客氣。

example.en: Many office workers patronize the sandwich shop at lunchtime.
example.zh: 許多上班族在午餐時間光顧那家三明治店。

senses.zh: 以高人一等的態度對待
senses.en: to talk to someone as if you know more than they do
senses.distinguish: 受詞是人，語氣不禮貌；don't patronize me 是這個意思。

example.en: He patronized the interns by repeating every instruction three times.
example.zh: 他把每項指示重複三次，對實習生擺出高人一等的態度。

extra_vocab.zh: 當時我就在那裡（說故事時的開場）
extra_vocab.en: a way to start telling what happened to you, often in a surprising or difficult moment
extra_vocab.note: 口語說故事用的開場語，用來描述「我當時就處在某個（常是尷尬或麻煩的）情境」，後面常接 -ing 或一段情況說明。多見於對話與閒聊，不是正式書面用語。
extra_vocab.pattern: There + I／we／he + was／were + V-ing／介系詞片語, + 情況
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 語序固定為 there + 代名詞 + was／were，不要寫成 there was I；I 一律大寫，要寫成 There I was。因為在講過去的事，所以用過去式。

examples.en: There I was, ready to present, and my laptop would not turn on.
examples.zh: 當時我準備好要簡報，結果筆電打不開。

examples.en: There I was, standing at the airport without my passport.
examples.zh: 當時我就站在機場，卻沒帶護照。

examples.en: There we were, waiting outside the office with no key.
examples.zh: 當時我們就在辦公室外面等，卻沒有鑰匙。

examples.en: There I was, in front of the client, and I forgot his name.
examples.zh: 當時我就站在客戶面前，卻忘了他的名字。

similar.diff: Picture this 是邀請對方想像一個場景，後面常接現在式；there I was 是回頭講自己過去的經歷。

example.en: Picture this: our biggest client walks in while we are still setting up.
example.zh: 想像一下：我們還在布置時，最大的客戶就走進來了。

similar.diff: I found myself + V-ing 語氣較中性、也可寫在文章裡；there I was 更口語、更戲劇化。

example.en: I found myself waiting alone in the lobby for two hours.
example.zh: 我發現自己一個人在大廳等了兩個小時。

confusable.diff: here I am 指現在人到了或在場；there I was 是回想過去的某個時刻。

example.en: Here I am, ready to start the training session.
example.zh: 我到了，準備好開始訓練課程。
